name: Hornero Clipboard
description: Private clipboard history for the launcher (>clipboard): text only, kept in memory and never written to disk, skips password-manager secrets, with retention, size and excluded-word limits you control. Pause, resume and clear are commands.
author: HorneroOS contributors

commands.title: Pause clipboard recording
commands.description: Stops the clipboard watcher; held entries stay searchable

changelog.notes: Initial release: >clipboard launcher provider (several rows, Enter copies), in-memory text history with retention, size and excluded-word limits, password-manager secrets skipped, pause/resume/clear commands. Needs the Hornero Shell with multi-row launcher results and PluginKit 4 commands.

recording.description: Record copied text while the extension is enabled. Off stops the wl-paste watcher entirely.

maxEntries.description: How many entries are held at most; the oldest are dropped first.

retentionMinutes.description: Erase entries after this many minutes; 0 keeps them until the shell restarts.

maxChars.description: Never record a copy longer than this many characters.

excludeWords.description: Comma-separated words; a copy containing any of them (case-insensitive) is never recorded.

skipSensitive.description: Skip copies that a password manager marks as secret (x-kde-passwordManagerHint).
